liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **One More Saturday Night** (2 reviews): Reviewer is surprised the show opens with it; Reviewer believes it was skipped the night before in Reno, so the Davis opener was a laugh [22][23]
- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): Described as a scorching version just before the break; Fast without sounding rushed, with sharply defined drums and cymbals [16][18]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Reviewer says 1982 has some of the best versions of this song [18]
- **Samson & Delilah** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Samson a great version [19]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): Playin' flows seamlessly into Scarlet, then Fire, then Drums, which the reviewer found unusual [17]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Intro out of Playin' is tight but rushed; Jerry begins singing before the band is ready for the chords [15]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Contains a rare Brent solo, the only one in Fire this reviewer has heard [17]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Reviewer likes the space leading into Not Fade Away [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-03-14.156433.sbd.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 175 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd82-03-14.sbd.clugston.7220.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 168 min; rated 4.14/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer reports good sound from the last row on the floor, center aisle; Second-set tape is evenly mixed, with good bass and drums, and Brent's keys sounding fresh on Scarlet; Crystal-clear sound; Jerry's guitar tone is clean and dynamic, and drums and cymbals are well defined [14][15][18][22]
- **gd1982-03-14.163600.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 21 songs; 170 min [6]
- **gd1982-03-14.139382.sbd.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 169 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls poor acoustics in the general-admission balcony and overbearing security staffed by Aggie football players [13]
- Reviewer suggests the band never returned to the venue, linking it to the heavy-handed security [13]
- Dancing area was restricted; security eased up after the fire marshal left and football players stepped back to watch [14]
- After Let It Grow, the sound engineer Healy played Dark Side of the Moon over the PA during the break [16]
- Judged less energetic than the previous night's Reno show, though still well played with a solid setlist [13]
- Judged not as good as the last night at the Greek, though better than anything else from that year [19]
- Contrasts with the Reno show the previous night, where this song apparently went unplayed [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-03-14.156433.sbd.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony D6) [1]. Also: Mark Severson's Nakamichi 700 source supplies crowd and openings of three songs, plus a 6:47 patch in Drums; An alternate soundboard fills most of One More Saturday Night because of azimuth problems on the master cassette [1]
- **gd82-03-14.sbd.clugston.7220.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Master soundboard cassette to reel-to-reel to DAT to CDR, mastered and shortened by Scott Clugston [2]
- **gd1982-03-14.163600.akg.se5.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Wiseman and Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [6]. Also: Mark Severson's Nakamichi 700 recording supplies crowd and song openings plus patches in Sugaree and Drums [6]
- **gd1982-03-14.139382.sbd.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Jason Chastain and Jamie Waddell; source: SBD > Reel Master > Cassette > Dat 44.1k [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by March: [GRATEFUL DEAD at UC Davis, CA 1982 Concert Poster~Rare! | #25218402](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-at-uc-davis-ca-1982-concert-poster) [26]
